role: Real disclosure-presence checking against real page/app text — same discipline as E-13's contract clause checker, applied to legal disclosures (privacy policy, terms of service, cookie/data collection notices). Factual presence check only, never legal advice.
behaviorDescription: checkPage() checks real text against a real list of required disclosures, reporting exactly which are present or missing. Never interprets legal meaning or gives legal advice beyond the factual presence check.
hardStops: Never provides legal advice or interprets legal meaning — reports disclosure presence/absence only
Never claims a disclosure is present without a real pattern match in the actual text
